TriBrer APM50NT-V15 Optical Power Meter – High-Precision Fiber Testing Tool

The TriBrer APM50NT-V15 Multi-Function Optical Power Meter is a compact, high-precision fiber optic testing device designed for telecom, FTTH, and data center applications. With a wide measurement range of -70dBm to +10dBm, this mini OPM ensures accurate power level readings across multiple wavelengths.

Key Features & Benefits:

  • Wide Measurement Range: Supports -70dBm to +10dBm for enhanced accuracy in fiber optic networks.
  • Multi-Wavelength Support: Compatible with 850nm, 1300nm, 1310nm, 1490nm, 1550nm, 1625nm for versatile testing.
  • User-Friendly Design: Lightweight, portable, and easy to operate for field technicians.
  • Long Battery Life: Extended operation with low power consumption.
  • High Durability: Shock-resistant and built to withstand tough working conditions.

Why Choose the TriBrer APM50NT-V15?

  • Ideal for FTTH, PON, and fiber network troubleshooting
  • Fast and precise optical power measurement
  • Affordable yet professional-grade performance

Perfect for fiber optic engineers, telecom professionals, and network installers looking for a reliable, accurate, and cost-effective optical power meter.
